description: List recent function calls, newest first: trigger kind and cause, outcome (succeeded, failed, timedOut, crashed...), HTTP status, duration and the first line of the error. Use it to find a failing call, then read that call whole with functions_get_call; to search every function's console output, use logs_search.

function.description: Only this function: its name or <region>-<name> id

outcome.description: Only calls that ended this way

q.description: Extra filter terms, e.g. took:>200ms status:>=500 is:cold

name: functions_list_calls
